inspection_scope: Complete data-only review of the script, film_structure, all three setups, and their linked beat-level shot contracts.

checks.evidence: Accuracy, growing cost, and permission are separated into s1, s2, and s3 with distinct heroes and rules; no setup is asked to operate target distance, receipt burden, and route release as one combined mechanism.
Hard cuts separate the setups, continuity_tokens is empty, and the plan does not retain the target, receipts, tray, latch, or route after their propositions end.
Each setup specifies one dominant semantic group: Bot/target in s1, Bot/receipt tray in s2, and Bot/latch-route in s3. No shot contract introduces unrelated dominant groups.

The three unrelated propositions use the identical composition contract: a central physical slab, small Bot at left, fixed wide camera, and the same paper wall/floor. Framing, depth planes, materials, palette, Bot role, entry state, and generic exit state also repeat; changing only the object from target to tray to switch does not provide continuity justification.
No continuity tokens are planned, and no object is specified to cross a setup boundary.
The environments contain only a paper backboard and work surface, while the corner crop is assigned an attentional function. No purposeless decorative geometry is specified.

Both semantic changes receive planned hard cuts and replacement heroes. Although the repeated staging causes compositional stagnation, the plan does provide explicit setup boundaries and does not drag prior mechanisms across them.
Each beat names one hero and one dominant action, with no secondary motion or additional active region planned.

The central actions themselves encode the propositions: distance selects the closest circle, accumulating receipts express growing burden, and depressing a latch visibly releases a route. Captions are not the sole planned source of meaning.

setup_assessments.evidence: Its accuracy proposition begins the repeated central-slab, small-left-Bot, fixed-wide staging later reused without continuity justification.
Its distinct cost proposition retains the same dominant silhouette, performer placement, environment, scale, and framing as s1 instead of establishing a composition suited to accumulation and burden.
Its permission proposition again uses the same central slab, small-left-Bot, fixed-wide arrangement despite introducing a different rule and evidence class.

violations.observation: Three consecutive, semantically unrelated propositions are staged as nearly identical wide shots: one central slab, a small Bot at left, and the same paper wall/floor. The target, receipt tray, and permission switch change, but the dominant spatial argument does not.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Keep the three setup boundaries and actions, but recompose at least one of the latter setups around its native relationship—for example, make s2 a tray/stack-dominant burden composition or s3 a route-and-gate composition—so no run of three unrelated propositions shares the same dominant silhouette and performer placement.

limits: This data-only review can assess planned structure, hierarchy, and semantic action, but cannot establish rendered clarity, actual mobile-glance performance, pixel visibility, motion execution, caption legibility, or listening experience.
